core_principle: learn HOW to rally, not HOW each event clicks. Target only changes what is being rallied.

optional_capability.AUTO_JOIN: only when target supports it (ICEFIELD_BEAST yes, BEAR no)

unification_rules.no_flow_duplication: FORBIDDEN to create BEAR_JOIN_RALLY / ICEFIELD_BEAST_JOIN_RALLY as separate skills; single JOIN_RALLY(target) / START_RALLY(target)
unification_rules.shared_pipeline: JOIN button / rally row / formation page / hero slots / troop / dispatch UI are identical across targets -> one pipeline, target passed as context parameter
unification_rules.target_specific_selectors: only for genuinely different entry points / target icons / target text

start_rally_contract.flow: SELECT_TARGET(target) -> START_RALLY -> HERO -> TROOP -> DISPATCH -> STARTED_RALLY verifier
start_rally_contract.limit: max 1 own active started rally; does NOT block JOIN_RALLY

join_rally_contract.join_affordance: green + button; locator = HSV green pixel clustering (band y380-520, x400-700) — template matching collides with orange flag at score 1.0 (2026-09-27 lesson)
join_rally_contract.confirm_dialog: JOIN_RALLY_CONFIRM = NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_THIS_FLOW (join -> formation dialog -> 出征 button directly)

success_signals_ranked: operator role/name visible in rally member list (strongest)
rally capacity delta == own troop power
city screen march queue count increase (行军 X/6)

dataset_convention.naming: flow=JOIN_RALLY target_type=BEAR (not bear_manual_join); ICEFIELD_BEAST frames later use same flow tag
dataset_convention.purpose: validate JOIN_RALLY generalizes across targets via offline replay

tonight_2030_failure_attribution: generic capabilities, not BEAR-specific: rally row parse returned UNKNOWN, JOIN locator hit orange flag, orphan device lease blocked retry — all engine-level fixes benefit every rally target
supersedes: any BEAR-only vs ICEFIELD-only rally flow distinction

findings.city_entry_card: 城屏左侧出现临时「冰原巨兽 N级 + 搜索 + 自动加入」入口卡；自动加入=AUTO_JOIN(ICEFIELD_BEAST) 专属开关，与 knowledge 一致；卡片为瞬态，数分钟内消失
findings.ordinary_beasts_not_rallyable: 普通野兽（雪豹等）对话框只有 出征，无 集结 —— 不可发起集结，属游戏规则
findings.beast_rally_row_example: [DIW]人间月 等级7霜鳞避役 9/15 集结中00:00:42 —— 野兽目标可被集结
findings.beast_name_filter: JOIN 目标词须覆盖具体兽名（避役/雪豹/猛犸/犀牛/棕熊/麋鹿/霜鳞…），仅 巨兽/野兽 会漏读 OCR 变体（冰原巨兽→冰原巨鲁）
findings.navigation_law: 世界地图上按 BACK 只会弹「确认退出游戏吗」；回城必须点底部导航 城镇 按钮
findings.popup_guard: 通用 JOIN 循环必须带弹窗防护：退出确认(取消)、充值礼包(￥/购买——只点 取消/关闭，禁点其他)、离线收益
